name: Cable Low-to-High Fly
steps: Stand centered just ahead of two low pulleys in a staggered stance with a handle in each hand.
Brace your core and hold your arms low and open with palms forward and elbows softly bent.
Sweep both handles forward and upward in wide arcs until your hands meet before your upper chest.
Squeeze your upper chest briefly, then open your arms back down under control.
tips: Keep a small, steady bend in each elbow throughout the arc.
Keep your torso steady instead of leaning forward to heave the handles up.
